writing_style: Europe's-reader desk. After the lead fact, say plainly who in Europe it touches and how: travellers, workers, households, a particular member state. Give every European actor their country on first mention, and put money in euros, converting when the source uses another currency. Explain any EU process in one plain clause rather than in its own vocabulary. Warm but neutral, medium-length sentences, three paragraphs. Close on what changes for people in Europe, and from when.
